name: Organisation Identification 38
definition: Identifies an organisation through client identification, a name and a domicile.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the organisation.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Indicates the name of the organisation.

Domicile.name: Domicile
Domicile.definition: Indicates the domicile of the organisation.
